topPRs.title: sepolia-devnet-3: add chain config
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Add sepolia-devnet-3 from devnets-private to the registry
- Add chain config, superchain config, compressed genesis, addresses, chainList, and CHAINS entry
- Public RPC verified at https://sepolia-devnet-3.optimism.io/rpc with eth_chainId `0x190aace2` (420130018)
- Per the devnet manifest, sepolia-devnet-3 is a permissioned Kona staging chain sharing the sepolia-devnet-2 superchain deployment (same `SuperchainConfigProxy` `0x289d2A1b1AE6E0470D8B72E53B6E3f485f251DBb` and OPCM `0xe5dF58eAf094F1FdA718c62dF709b81c41f80491`); like sepolia-devnet-2 it is registered as its own superchain target

## Import details
- Source: `devnets-private/stg/sepolia-devnet-3/op-deployer/state.json`
- Imported with `ops/cmd/import_devnet` + `ops/cmd/sync_staging` using the op-deployer `v0.7.1` release binary (matches the state file's `opDeployerVersion` `0.7.1-75254822-2026-05-27T13:58:19Z`)
- The staged `superchain.toml` was written by hand: `import_devnet`'s superchain-definition step fails on v0.7.x state files because `ReadOpcmImpl` doesn't know the `implementationsDeployment.OpcmV2Impl` key; the values are taken directly from the state file's `superchainContracts` / `implementationsDeployment`
- Genesis and rollup values cross-checked against `devnets-private/stg/sepolia-devnet-3/sepolia-devnet-3/rollup.json`, and the live network's genesis block hash (`eth_getBlockByNumber 0x0`) matches `genesis.l2.hash` (`0xaab365bf4b86a69dcec883fdd462a8d8eccd7947e1fcb8a25b67be1e82bdbf79`)

## Validation
- `just check-chainlist`
- `just check-genesis-integrity`
- `cd ops && go run ./cmd/check_depsets/main.go`
- `go test ./...` in `ops` and `validation` with `SEPOLIA_RPC_URL`/`MAINNET_RPC_URL`/`DEPLOYER_CACHE_DIR` set (plain `go test` because the gotestsum version pinned in the justfile does not build on go 1.26)
